releaseControl.candidateIdentity: the authoritative final candidate is the clean full commit recorded by the exact release-contract evidence after this tree is committed

wholeProduct.summary: D8 corrects one Community feed-view discoverability defect without changing the released AppShell, Scout workspace, action authority, or Community route behavior.

deliverables.outcome: The authenticated shell, Scout task workspace, Community handoff, action law, and production release identity remain protected.
Every Community geography and feed-view control is visible on initial mobile render without guessing a horizontal gesture, while desktop remains a single row with contained keyboard focus paint.
deliverables.entry: Open the authenticated or guest Community feed at a viewport from 320 through 640 CSS pixels.
deliverables.ending: See the geography axis before the feed axis, with every present control fully visible, keyboard reachable, and at least 44 pixels high. Normal text uses two rows; enlarged text may wrap each axis further without clipping or reordering controls.
journeySteps: Open Community without changing the selected geography or feed.
See Near me and Explore together as the geography axis.
See For you, Newest, and authenticated Saved together as the feed axis.
Use the same DOM order, labels, aria-pressed state, URLs, and handlers as before.
At 641 pixels and wider, retain the existing one-row viewbar and divider while reserving four pixels for its existing focus paint.

proof.procedure: Measure the exact released b21 Community viewbar before correction at authenticated 320, 360, and 390 widths and guest 320, 360, and 390 widths.
proof.observed: Authenticated Saved was absent from view at 320 and 360 and 71 percent clipped at 390. Guest Newest was clipped at 320 and 360. Desktop fit all controls.

proof.procedure: Apply the bounded divider row-break as temporary page CSS, measure authenticated and guest 320, 360, 390, and 640, then remove the style and close the isolated tabs.
proof.observed: Every present mobile control was contained, 44 pixels high, and focus-visible; nav and page horizontal overflow were absent. Final current-source proof retained the 641-plus one-row layout and added a four-pixel top and logical-inline focus inset.

proof.procedure: Run the two Community shell and surface contracts, broader Community parity and CVS contracts, TypeScript, law guards, and the exact Playwright geometry regression.
proof.observed: Source contracts, broader unit contracts, TypeScript, guards, and the exact modified Playwright geometry regression pass. The final committed-candidate gate remains a release condition until recorded in evidence.

protectedRequirements: No AppShell, D7 Scout, Community handler, route, API, schema, persistence, county, contact, or Trust/CVS owner changes.
Saved remains authenticated-only and retains its local vault route behavior.
Historical D2 non-wrapping evidence remains historical; D8 supersedes only mobile widths through 640 pixels.
